docs.title: Team Charter
docs.text: HaMaLoYa aims to provide awareness and safety for drivers who may encounter drowsiness or fatigue while behind the wheel.

docs.title: Product Mission Statement
docs.text: HaMaLoYa's mission is to improve driver safety by developing an effective solution that can respond to fatigue or drowsiness, as these situations could happen at any moment.

docs.text:
Figure 3.2 Driver Drowsiness Alarm

  • Price: $39.99

docs.title: Positive Comments
docs.text: Voice of the Customer Restated Customer Need “I really like the concept behind this device. Anything that helps promote safer driving and increase awareness of fatigue or distractions while on the road is something I can appreciate. The idea of having a system that can monitor for signs of drowsiness and help remind drivers to stay alert is very appealing, especially for long drives or people who spend a lot of time behind the wheel. The unit itself appears compact and easy to place inside a vehicle without taking up much space. It also seems straightforward to set up, which is always a plus when adding accessories to a car. Overall, I think this is a clever idea with a focus on safety. The technology and features are interesting, and it has the potential to be a valuable tool for drivers looking for an extra layer of awareness while traveling.  ” 1. The product promotes safe driving(explicit)  2.The product monitors for signs of drowsiness(explicit)  3. The product helps keep drivers alert(explicit) N/A N/A N/A N/A

docs.title: Negative Comments
docs.text: Voice of the Customer Restated Customer Need “ This device certainly has a good concept, but it also has too many flaws. Of course, you cannot compare it to commercial versions with their much higher price tags. Pros: It performs certain functions when properly set up. It has a relatively low price compared to other devices. Compact size. Cons: Does not work with sunglasses. Only a few functions work with regular clear glasses. No ability to adjust the volume. Too many false-positive prompts. Since it is advertised as an AI device, it would be very helpful to have an interface that allows users to customize the settings and possibly train the AI to better recognize the driver and specific behaviors. It is also essential that the device work with both regular glasses and sunglasses. On sunny days, you simply have to wear sunglasses, so this is an important limitation. Overall, the device is an interesting concept and does perform some useful functions, but it still needs significant improvements to be truly practical for everyday use ” 1.The product is affordable (explicit)  2.The product functions as intended (explicit)  3.The product is compact (explicit)  4.The product works even with sunglasses on (explicit)  5.The product functions as intended with regular clear glasses (explicit)  5.The product has adjustable volume control (explicit)  6.The product recognizes individuals behavior (latent)  7.The product is practical for everyday use (explicit)  8.The product overall concept is good and works well (latent)  9.The product is comparable to more expensive commercial versions (latent) “DMS Driver Monitoring System AI Fatigue Warning Device with Face Recognition Alerts for Eye Closing Yawning Smoking Phone Use & Distraction Works for All Vehicles. This DMS Driver Monitoring System AI Fatigue Warning Device with Face Recognition Alerts for Eye Closing Yawning Smoking Phone Use and Distraction does what it advertises in the right conditions. Setup was straightforward and it mounts easily on the dash, and it does catch eye closing and yawning with an audible alert that is loud enough to get your attention. Face recognition works consistently in daylight and it correctly flagged phone use and looking away from the road during my testing. Would’ve liked maybe better low light performance because accuracy drops at night or with glare from streetlights, and it gave a few false alerts when I was just talking or wearing sunglasses. Would recommend with reservations because the concept is solid for long drives and fleet use, and the alerts are immediate without lag. The system installs in any vehicle and does not need phone integration, which is convenient. Best for daytime highway driving where fatigue is a risk, but do not rely on it as your only safety measure. Good idea and decent execution, just expect some calibration quirks and occasional false positives.  ” 1.The product set up is straightforward (explicit)  2.The product detects yawning and reacts to keep the driver alert (explicit)  3.The product detects eyes closing and reacts to keep the driver alert (explicit)  4.The product recognizes the drivers face in daylight (explicit)  5.The product recognizes when the driver is using a phone (explicit)  6.The product works as well in low light (explicit)  7.The product can tell between talking or wearing sunglasses as a false alert (explicit)  8.The product does not need phone integration (explicit)  9.The product has little to no false positive alerts (explicit) N/A N/A

docs.title: 3. Pavlok Shock Clock 3
docs.text:
Figure 3.3 Pavlok Shock Clock 3

  • Price: $164.99

  • Vendor: Amazon

  • Description: Shock Clock delivers an electric shock that has proven to wake up even the heaviest sleepers, allowing you to sleep soundly without having to stress if you will be late in the morning. The vibrate > beep > zap sequence teaches your brain when it’s time to wake up.

docs.title: Positive Comments
docs.text: Voice of the Customer Restated Customer Need “I have REM sleep behavior disorder, and POTS, and sleep has always been an issue. Also constantly having incredibly deep sleep often, and super interactive dreams, and sleep terrors. When my alarm (actually my 20 alarms + separate alarm clock + another separate alarm clock across the room that buzzes the heck out of me bed) goes off, but I’m stuck in a dream or deep sleep and don’t hear a single alarm. Oversleep by an hour, late to work. It was not looking good for me. Even with proper medication, maintaining good sleep habits, exercising, eating well, working closely with multiple specialists, I STILL couldn’t wake up. No matter what I did. But I have to say - THIS WATCH FIXED ME. It sucks is that the only way to get unstuck from a dream or deep sleep, I have to be zapped hard and annoyingly. It jolts me awake and gets me moving with a fire under my bottom. It’s been maybe 6 months of using it, and I haven’t had a single “missed alarms” occurrence since using it. It’s amazing. If you are the worst with alarms, this will help you. There is an adjustment period, you have to figure out what works best for you and that is learning curve, but it’s so adjustable and has more than zapping. So give it a go!” 1. Reliable method of waking up through physical vibrations or electric shocks rather than sound alarms (explicit). 2. Device is operable with individuals who may suffer from REM sleep behavioral disorders or POTS, and may be a good tool to work around sleep issues (latent). 3. Delivering electrical zaps are said to instantly wake up the user no matter the circumstance (explicit). 4. The device helps build consistent habits, most notably as an alarm for waking up (latent). “A more expensive purchase for me for sure, but absolutely worth it. I have struggled for a very long time being able to wake from deep sleep. I have never been successful with sound alarms and knew I needed to invest in a more reliable device/method. I love this watch. The set up with the app on my phone was very streamlined. Even when my device disconnects, it reconnects on its own making it incredibly reliable. I think it is supposed to be marketed for an everyday use as well, but has no other features for everyday use. I think it would be great to have even just a digital clock on the watch face. I only wear it when sleeping because it does not have any beneficial use to me personally outside of that. The watch band is comfortable and setting up alarms is a super easy process. I have never had any issues with any of the features that I use it for. I have had mine for about two years now and it still works as well as it did the day that I bought it.” 1. Sound-alarms prove to be unsuccessful to some individuals, making the electric shock worth it (latent). 2. Device is easy to use and set up (explicit). 3. Device is comfortable to be worn for long durations (through the night, etc.) (explicit). 4. The electric shock is a reliable and consistent way to remove the user from any state of sleep (explicit). 5. User says the device has a long lifespan, insinuating good durability (latent). “Annoying but it'll get you outta bed! Gotta do them jumping jacks or you'll get shocked. Don't turn it up to 10, im warning you now! 5 or 6 is plenty. If you turn it up past that and sleep through the alarm, you'll be in a lot of hurt! I woke up with the watch shocking me after a solid 10 minutes. I didn't notice how uncomfortable it was until I awoke of course. I dread this thing now and make sure I wake up before it starts to spark and snap my wrist. There was a couple times where I basically ripped it off me because it didn't recognize my fake jumping jacks” 1. The user states it has a mode that’s quite powerful for the deepest of sleepers (explicit). 2. The device has a standard alarm, which trains the user that the electric shock will come if they fail to wake up sooner (explicit). 3. The user finds this device reliable and useful for the sole purpose of waking up instantly (explicit).

docs.title: Negative Comments
docs.text: Voice of the Customer Restated Customer Need “The Pavlok 3 feels like a product in beta testing with incredibly inadequate owners guide. What is delivered is a "watch" face directing one to the Pavlok.com app, which immediately starts trying to sell you the "watch" you just bought. Eventually you then discover that you need the Pavlok 3 app from Apple/Android to make it work; then charge it for 90 minutes with battery lfe estimated at 3-5 days. Next pair it USING PAVLOK 3 app, and finally things begin to be easier. Setting up the alarm functions on the app is easy and some degree of customization is allowed. I bought this ONLY because I am a heavy sleeper; the 50% setting for zap seems about right for me time will tell. Wasn't interested in "changing habits" ... Something allegedly it can do. It will be interesting to see if it can track my sleep; couldn't find the setting for this. Owners manual provided is a joke; it prints out entire manual on one page of type so small as to be illegible even with a magnifying glass. The only way I figured how to configure and set up was by bugging Google/You Tube for help ... Fortunately there's a lot of You Tube help, as provided owners manual is useless. Feels like a device in development with little customer service/support. For $180 this is a poor value; may return. Later I realized that the app makes the assumption that you keep your phone adjacent to the pavlok watch, otherwise it unpairs and then becomes useless. This has so much potential, and it is so expensive, but it is a joke as is.” 1. The owner's guide needs to be understandable (explicit). 2. Setting up alarm functions within the app is an easy process (explicit). 3. The customer needed to find a solution to wake up more abruptly since they’re a heavy sleeper, leading them to purchase this device (latent). 4. Good-quality customer support should be provided for any help that the customer requires (explicit). 5. The device needs to be affordable in what its functionality can offer (explicit). 6. The device requires close proximity with a paired phone (explicit). “I’ve been using this as an alarm for the past 2 months it works quite well, however I notice there’s an issue when the battery gets too low(around 40%) the alarm won’t go off thus I recommend keeping it charged otherwise it does it's job quite well” 1. The battery life needs to last an adequate amount of time aside from charging, also ensuring that >40% won’t hinder functionality (explicit). 2. The device works well and wakes up the user as intended (implicit). “It's junk. I can't figure out why this thing is so expensive because it can't be made of anything good. I have $25 Bluetooth earbuds that have better connectivity than this thing. It worked waking me up exactly one time when I managed to pair it to my phone (Pixel 6) with difficulty. This thing will constantly fail to connect until you finally get it to go through one time (on a miracle). Problem is, it constantly disconnects itself. So, every time you go to bed you have to go into the Pavlok app and re-sync the thing to get it to work. However, even if you do that you are rolling the dice that the thing won't randomly disconnect itself from your phone in the middle of the night and fail to wake you up in the morning because of it. The whole point of this watch is to reliably wake up heavy sleepers and it can't even do that. It's useless without the app and it has no screen (despite it's price) so you have to rely on some light system on the side of the watch to determine what state that it is in. The connectivity of this thing is so bad that it now won't even pair to my phone at all (see video). It constantly just fails on "syncing alarms" (of which I only have one). I tried all their troubleshooting steps of forgetting the device in Bluetooth settings and trying to pair it over and over again but nothing works. I have the watch plugged in and sitting right next to my phone and this thing still can't connect. Now, imagine this thing working from over 10 feet away (not happening). I can't think that my phone is the problem as I have several other Bluetooth devices connected to it without any issues (a galaxy watch, Anker Bluetooth earbuds, and Razer Bluetooth headphones). I would give it a higher star rating because it isn't uncomfortable to wear and it can shock you to wake you up however since it can't even perform the one basic function it was created for I can't give it anything other than one star. I'm going to try to return it as it's junk that can't be relied on. It's basically useless at this point since it can't pair with the app on my phone. I'd rather it not end up in a landfill or worse in the ocean where it chokes out some poor sea turtle, but honestly, I don't think it could even manage to do that right.” 1. Connectivity needs to be reliable in that the user won’t encounter constant disconnecting between the device and the phone app (explicit). 2. Alarm feature and properly waking up is reliable as long as the device is connected (latent). 3. Ensuring the device has a reliable bluetooth connection radius to the phone will have the user feel confident that the device will function as intended, waking up the user on time regardless of the state of sleep they’re in (important for heavy sleepers) (latent). 4. The device is comfortable to wear (explicit).

docs.title: Need Statement Process
docs.text:
After compiling the statements into a list of 100 entries, the group went through all the user statements and separated them based on what question they answer:

  • Does the product actually wake you up?
  • Does the product work as intended?
  • Is the product good quality?
  • How long can the product last?
  • Is the product comfortable and convenient for the consumer?
  • How is the product perceived in the public eye?

Then, as shown in Figure 3.6 below, six statements were selected to be the meta statements for each category.

Figure 3.6 Selected meta statements

The list of 100 statements was then divided up by which question it answered best and counted. The highest priorities for the product was decided based on the number of statements each category had.

docs.title: Project Objective
docs.text:
This project aims to design and develop an awareness device for drivers who may experience drowsiness and fatigue. The product will have a system with components that include an audible buzzer, flashing LED, actuator, and motion sensor that will all trigger a response to alert the driver if they start experiencing fatigue or drowsiness. The product is planned to be convenient, compact, rechargeable, and easy for the driver to use.

Objective Specifics Units Battery life Should last 8 hours minimum, have a rechargeable feature Hours Size Should not exceed 11in x 5in x 4in in Weight Should not exceed 5 lbs lbs Visually Appealing Should make at least 75% of the customers rate the product visually appealing percentage of positive reviews on aesthetic of product Buzzer alarm Reacts to motion sensor to trigger buzzer for user to stay awake Decibels Motion sensor Should detect head movement, if head is within 10 cm of sensor, will trigger assuming the driver is falling asleep cm LED Reacts to motion sensor to trigger flash to alert the user to stay awake Lumen Actuator Should tap the driver to wake them up by rotating from 0 to 90 degrees and 90 to 180 degrees Degrees 5V Regulator Should maintain an output voltage of 5V to the system Volts

docs.title: Stakeholders
docs.text:
• Target group Drivers who spend long hours on the road. Narcoleptic people who have trouble focusing on driving.
  • Target purchaser Target group with special attention to families of unsafe drivers.
  • Customer service Prefers easy to service products with comfort and convenience as a selling point.
  • Marketing & Sales division Looks for unique selling points around safety and comfort when driving.
  • Retailers Prefer products that can withstand a wide range of storage conditions including hot car temperatures, long battery life, fits in with the design of a car interior.

docs.title: User Story #1: Jenna
docs.text:
Jenna is a 33-year-old executive who regularly visits a bar for lunch to blow off some steam. The bar is often loud with people, but it is paramount that she can hold business conversations over the phone there. Then again, she does not want to miss out on the atmosphere and be able to hear the waiters as well. Her new Apple wireless earphones allow her to switch instantly between a mode where she can fully focus on the phone conversation and a mode where the phone call and environmental sound are seamlessly combined. They also allow her to rapidly adjust the volume on the earbuds themselves without having to take out her phone.

Jenna occasionally visits the bar in the evenings. She is a big fan of the L.A. Lakers, and whenever they play, she streams the live footage through her phone. Her new earbuds allow her to easily switch to hearing everything around her and streaming the match commentary without having to ever take the earbuds out. She sometimes gets compliments on how stylish the earbuds look on her, and she wouldn’t want to miss out on hearing those either.

docs.title: Aspects
docs.text:
The new product design will be based on that of the AirPods with improvements based on the following requirements. The P1 - P10 is the "code" to indicate the priority of the requirement, from low to high.

  1. Producer Design
  2. 1.1 The product shall be visually easy to distinguish from existing AirPods as well as main competitors Sony WF-1000XM3, Jabra Elite, Amazon Echo Buds, Samsung Galaxy Buds, and Bose SoundSport Free, and Urbanista Stockholm. (P10)
  3. 1.1 The product shall be easy to recognize as an Apple product without needing a logo on its exterior. (P10)

  4. 1.2. The product shall avoid styling elements from our Powerbeats over-ear wireless headphones since those address a different market segment. (P8)

  5. Functionality

    • 2.1 The product shall incorporate one or more optical proximity sensors to detect the user wearing it. (P10)
    • 2.2 The product shall offer a dual microphone in each earbud. (P10)

docs.title: Team Coordination and Accountability
docs.text:
The team will make sure the assignments are submitted before the due date and make sure each team member has ok’d before submitting, by having the project monitor ensure the work is completed 12 hours before the due date. The team will make sure each member has the knowledge and skill needed for each assignment, and will we adjust by having transparent communication, and being open minded on feedback. The team will make sure the feedback given from our design review is distributed and acted on by each team member during our weekly check ins to make sure each member is updated on everything.

Additional questions were asked between the team:

  1. How will the team address missed contributions/assignments/actions? The project monitor will text the person privately.
  2. How will the team hold each other accountable to the expectations of the charter? As a team we can reflect on who did what after each project or assignment in order to figure out responsibility moving forward.
  3. How will the team recognize that a team member is underperforming? Depending on the amount of work designated and quality of work to the member. We will do overall weekly check ins to see if anyone is struggling.
  4. How will the team help an underperforming team member improve? As a team we can offer assistance and help the individual improve their team work and collaboration skills.
  5. What is the agreed upon consequence if an underperforming team member doesn’t improve? We will try to communicate first. If there is no improvement, we will move forward with the pink slip.

docs.title: Conflict Recognition & Resolution
docs.text:
The team handle disagreements during the weekly check ins to discuss any issues and try to solve it as a team. We will make sure everyone feels comfortable expressing their opinion by having constant open dialogue. We will prevent conflicts of interest, or if one person is taking on too many roles by assigning roles/duties as a team for every project.

The steps we decided on to resolve conflicts will be: 1. Ask with an open dialogue about needed support 2. Reminder about assigned duties 3. Team assistance for one assignment 4. Contact the instructor

We decided that a problem that will get an instructor involved is if a team member has to take over another person's responsibility to submit the assignment on time more than once. The current meeting leader or meeting recorder will contact the instructor if a conflict needs to be addressed by them. Overall, the agreed upon process for resolving conflicts is through communication at weekly check ins with all members present.
